notes.title: Cursed Treasure 2 Ultimate Edition Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello Cursed Treasure fans! We're dropping by with some great news! 

[b]SureFire Games and Iriysoft have just released a remastered version of Cursed Treasure 2 that also has some new difficulty balancing.[/b] Whether you've not picked up the classic version or are just nostalgic for another dose of this beloved classic, this might be just what you've been waiting for.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1368850/Cursed_Treasure_2_Ultimate_Edition__Tower_Defense/

For those of you who have already purchased Cursed Treasure 2, there's a complete-the-bundle option that will allow you to get the new one at a discount. 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27137/Cursed_Treasure_2_Evil_Evolution_Bundle/
